rulings: CF-ONE-SALE-ONE-ADDRESS (2026-09-05): one sale resident under two cardId partitions is a split pool AND a double count. Never a delete -- RETIRE marks flaggedWrong, and it is reversible.

CF-A-VERIFY-MISMATCH-IS-A-DUPLICATE-NOT-A-FAILURE (#1850): relocateSoldComp upserts the keeper BEFORE it reads back, and deletes nothing when the read-back fails. A "FAILED at verify" line therefore can never mean the write was lost -- it can only mean a duplicate was left. All 49 rows here are that duplicate, not a missing sale.

The keeper is identified by the run's OWN stamp, never by address alone: rekeyedAt within 227ms of the log line, rekeyedReason "GREAT REMATCH (2026-09-01): IMPROVE, ...", and a rekeyedFrom naming the retired address. A row carrying no rekeyedAt is not this fleet's and is not in this list.

tca-ebay::117210597158 is resident at THREE addresses. Only the stale-read-back twin (hiq:hockey:2025:unknown:60:base:no-auto) is retired here. The third copy, hiq:hockey:2025:bowman:60:base:no-auto, is LEFT IN PLACE; maker-default split, own census -- it predates the rematch (_ts 1786405617, no rekeyedAt, absent from the keeper's rekeyedFrom) and is not a read-back artifact.

provenance.finding: the 60 "read-back found nothing" lines from the GREAT REMATCH IMPROVE fleet (backfill-runner, rematch-sold-comps, APPLY_SCOPE=improve, 32 slots)

classified.note: class (c) is empty and cannot be non-empty: the upsert is checked for success before the read-back runs. The 11 class-(b) ids were re-relocated by a LATER pass (rekeyedAt 2.3-7.6h after their log line), which collapsed the duplicate on its own; they need no action.

provenance.allPre1850: Every one of the 49 came from the PRE-#1850 passes -- slots 0-15, 2026-09-05T05:22Z-14:44Z -- running the helper that believed the first null point-read. The post-fix passes (slots 16-31, 23:01Z onward) logged ZERO "read-back found nothing"; their failures are all the other, "read-back differs" class. This list is therefore closed: the cause is fixed and no new members can appear.
provenance.notAThrottle: Not a slot, hot-partition or 429 effect. ALL 60 changed partition (41 off a vendor bubble id onto an hiq: slug, 19 slug->slug), which is exactly the Eventual-consistency surface #1850 documents; the failures spread across each apply pass rather than bunching, and the failing runs show no more 429 retry traffic than the clean ones.
provenance.APPLY_ORDER: NO IMPROVE FLEET PASS MAY RUN BETWEEN MERGE AND APPLY. The 49 retired addresses still match the IMPROVE predicate (32 sit on a vendor bubble partition, 5 more on an hiq: slug containing `unknown`), so a fleet pass would re-relocate them and race this list. Apply first, then resume the fleet.
